Name: Animated Wooden Turbine
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
This mod replaces your solar panels with mini wooden turbines (It's the spinning thing from Leah's cottage :p), the mod is inspired by Kaya's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8780?tab=description]Wind Turbine[/url], a very cool mod but I wanted something more rustic to fit my farm theme.

How to use:

1. Buy a Paint Bucket from Robin.

2. Use it on your solar panel.

3. Enjoy!
